queries.details: Inspect wide exterior property images, surrounding vegetation images, driveway images, road images, address verification images, GPS images, and any image showing general access to the dwelling.

entities.entity: Are there wildlands, such as forests, woodlands, dense brush fields, overgrown grasslands, etc., within 1000 ft of dwelling?
data_validation_rules: Look beyond maintained landscaping.
Include dense brush, woodland, forest, and unmanaged vegetation.

entities.entity: Does the house have year-round access and are the road surfaces maintained and do they reflect safe access, turnaround ability, no restrictions due to overgrowth of vegetation, and/or grade/maintenance?
data_validation_rules: Inspect road surface, driveway, access route, and turnaround area.
Look for blocked access, unsafe grade, poor maintenance, or vegetation restrictions.

properties.group_name: Wildland Exposure, General Property View, and Access

queries.details: Inspect images showing directional slope, terrain grade, surrounding vegetation, and the relationship between the dwelling and vegetation on each side.

entities.entity: What is the house-to-vegetation position on the north side?
data_validation_rules: Determine whether north-side vegetation is uphill, downhill, or level from the dwelling.

entities.entity: What is the house-to-vegetation position on the south side?
data_validation_rules: Determine whether south-side vegetation is uphill, downhill, or level from the dwelling.

entities.entity: What is the house-to-vegetation position on the east side?
data_validation_rules: Determine whether east-side vegetation is uphill, downhill, or level from the dwelling.

entities.entity: What is the house-to-vegetation position on the west side?
data_validation_rules: Determine whether west-side vegetation is uphill, downhill, or level from the dwelling.

entities.entity: What is the degree range of the north slope?
data_validation_rules: Use the labeled slope range if shown.
Use Unclear if slope is visible but not measurable.

entities.entity: What is the degree range of the south slope?
data_validation_rules: Use the labeled slope range if shown.
Use Unclear if slope is visible but not measurable.

entities.entity: What is the degree range of the east slope?
data_validation_rules: Use the labeled slope range if shown.
Use Unclear if slope is visible but not measurable.

entities.entity: What is the degree range of the west slope?
data_validation_rules: Use the labeled slope range if shown.
Use Unclear if slope is visible but not measurable.

queries.details: Inspect images showing the roof, roof edges, chimney, chimney top, eaves, soffits, gutters, upper exterior walls, and nearby trees or branches.

entities.entity: Are there tree branches within 10 feet of or overhanging the chimney?
data_validation_rules: Focus on the chimney and nearby branches.Use N/A if no chimney is present.

entities.entity: Are the chimneys unscreened/missing flue cap/missing spark arrestor?
data_validation_rules: Inspect the chimney top.Use N/A if no chimney is present.

entities.entity: Are there tree branches touching or overhanging the roof?
data_validation_rules: Look for branches above or touching the roof.

entities.entity: Is the roof wood?
data_validation_rules: Answer Yes only for wood shake or wood shingle roofing.

entities.entity: Are eaves boxed in for any single story or first floor roof line?
data_validation_rules: Boxed in means the underside of the eave is enclosed.

properties.group_name: Roof, Chimney, Eaves, and Roof-Contact Vegetation

queries.details: Inspect close and distant images of siding, exterior walls, wall base, foundation, crawlspace areas, vents, louvers, flanges, and vegetation immediately near or touching the exterior walls.

entities.entity: Are there naturally occurring trees/plants/fuels or coniferous landscaping within 0 to 5 ft of the dwelling?
data_validation_rules: Limit the inspection to 0 to 5 ft from exterior walls.
Exclude maintained lawn.

entities.entity: Is the foundation open?
data_validation_rules: Open foundation means exposed space below the dwelling.
Answer No if the foundation is enclosed.

entities.entity: Is the siding made of non-combustible material?
data_validation_rules: Stone, brick, cement, stucco, metal, and masonry count as non-combustible.
Wood and vinyl count as combustible.

entities.entity: Does the lowest 6 inches of the exterior wall, that meets the ground, have non-combustible material?
data_validation_rules: Inspect the wall base where it meets the ground.
Stone, brick, concrete, stucco, and metal count as non-combustible.

entities.entity: Do all louvers/flanges/vents have metal screens made of 1/8 inch or finer mesh?
data_validation_rules: Inspect only visible vents, louvers, and flanges.
Use N/A if no vents are present.

entities.entity: Are there tree limbs/vegetation, other than landscaping, touching siding?
data_validation_rules: Exclude maintained landscaping unless it touches siding.

properties.group_name: Siding, Exterior Wall Base, Foundation, Vents, and Wall-Adjacent Vegetation

queries.details: Inspect images showing decks, porches, walkways, walking surfaces, joists, underside areas, railings, deck edges, deck-to-wall connections, and flashing.

entities.entity: Are decks made of metal?
data_validation_rules: Answer Yes only if the deck structure appears metal.
Use N/A if no deck is present.

entities.entity: Do all decks use metal joists and have a walking surface other than wood?
data_validation_rules: Check both joists and walking surface.
Answer No if any visible deck fails either condition.

entities.entity: Do wood decks/walkways touching combustible material, such as wood siding or vinyl siding, have flashing?
data_validation_rules: Inspect the contact point with combustible siding.
Flashing must be visible.
Use N/A if there is no wood deck or walkway touching combustible siding.

entities.entity: Are decks residing less than 4 feet from the ground enclosed with fire-resistant materials such as metal screening, mesh 1/8 inch or finer, and clear of any flammable material underneath?
data_validation_rules: Apply only to decks less than 4 feet from the ground.
Check for fire-resistant enclosure.
Check for flammable material underneath.

properties.group_name: Decks, Walkways, Joists, Walking Surface, Flashing, and Deck Enclosure

queries.details: Inspect images showing fences, gates, fence attachments, wall connections, siding near fence contact points, and the first 5 feet of fencing attached to the dwelling.

entities.entity: Are the first 5 feet of fencing attached to the home made of non-combustible materials?
data_validation_rules: Apply only to fencing attached to the dwelling.
Wood and vinyl are not acceptable.

entities.entity: Does a wood or vinyl fence have flashing between the fence and the combustible siding?
data_validation_rules: Apply only to wood or vinyl fencing attached to combustible siding.
Flashing must be visible.

queries.details: Inspect images showing the ground within 0 to 5 ft of the dwelling, mulch beds, landscaping beds, porches, yard edges, walkways, stored materials, lumber, woodpiles, playsets, pet houses, sheds, and other combustible objects near the dwelling.

entities.entity: Are there combustible mulch products?
data_validation_rules: Look for wood chips, bark, shredded wood, or rubber mulch.
Stone, gravel, and bare soil are not combustible mulch.

entities.entity: Are there woodpiles, lumber, or combustible playsets/pet houses/sheds?
data_validation_rules: Limit the inspection to the 0 to 5 ft zone.
Include firewood, lumber, playsets, pet houses, and sheds.

properties.group_name: Immediate 0 to 5 ft Combustible Ground Fuels and Movable Combustibles

queries.details: Inspect images showing trees around the dwelling, especially trees in the 5 to 30 ft zone and 30 to 100 ft zone. Prioritize images that show tree trunks, lower branches, ground clearance, tree height, pruning condition, distance zone, and direction.

entities.entity: Are trees 18 feet or taller pruned up at least 6 feet from the ground, and trees less than 18 feet pruned at least 1/3 the height of the tree in the 5 to 30 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Limit to trees in the 5 to 30 ft zone.
Answer No if any visible tree fails.

entities.entity: Are trees in the north 5 to 30 ft zone properly pruned?
data_validation_rules: Use the 5 to 30 ft pruning standard.
Use N/A if no north-side trees are present.

entities.entity: Are trees in the south 5 to 30 ft zone properly pruned?
data_validation_rules: Use the 5 to 30 ft pruning standard.
Use N/A if no south-side trees are present.

entities.entity: Are trees in the east 5 to 30 ft zone properly pruned?
data_validation_rules: Use the 5 to 30 ft pruning standard.
Use N/A if no east-side trees are present.

entities.entity: Are trees in the west 5 to 30 ft zone properly pruned?
data_validation_rules: Use the 5 to 30 ft pruning standard.
Use N/A if no west-side trees are present.

entities.entity: Are trees 18 feet or taller pruned up at least 6 feet from the ground, and trees less than 18 feet pruned at least 1/3 the height of the tree in the 30 to 100 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Limit to trees in the 30 to 100 ft zone.
Answer No if any visible tree fails.

entities.entity: Are trees in the north 30 to 100 ft zone properly pruned?
data_validation_rules: Use the 30 to 100 ft pruning standard.
Use N/A if no north-side trees are present.

entities.entity: Are trees in the south 30 to 100 ft zone properly pruned?
data_validation_rules: Use the 30 to 100 ft pruning standard.
Use N/A if no south-side trees are present.

entities.entity: Are trees in the east 30 to 100 ft zone properly pruned?
data_validation_rules: Use the 30 to 100 ft pruning standard.
Use N/A if no east-side trees are present.

entities.entity: Are trees in the west 30 to 100 ft zone properly pruned?
data_validation_rules: Use the 30 to 100 ft pruning standard.
Use N/A if no west-side trees are present.

properties.group_name: Tree Pruning by Zone and Direction

queries.details: Inspect images showing tree crowns, canopy gaps, tree groups, tree clusters, slope direction, and vegetation around the dwelling. Compare canopy spacing against the applicable slope rule.

entities.entity: Do tree crowns/canopy have appropriate spacing according to slope in the 5 to 30 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Limit to tree crowns in the 5 to 30 ft zone.
Apply the spacing rule that matches the slope.

entities.entity: For flat to mild slope, 0% to 19%, do tree crowns/canopy have at least 10 feet of spacing in the 5 to 30 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Apply only when the slope is flat to mild.

entities.entity: For mild to moderate slope, 20% to 40%, do tree crowns/canopy have at least 20 feet of spacing in the 5 to 30 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Apply only when the slope is mild to moderate.

entities.entity: For moderate to steep slope, greater than 40%, do tree crowns/canopy have at least 30 feet of spacing in the 5 to 30 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Apply only when the slope is moderate to steep.

entities.entity: Are there 4 or more trees in a cluster within the 30 to 100 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Count trees that form one visible cluster.
Limit to the 30 to 100 ft zone.

entities.entity: Do tree crowns/canopy have appropriate spacing according to slope in the 30 to 100 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Limit to tree crowns in the 30 to 100 ft zone.
Apply the spacing rule that matches the slope.

entities.entity: For flat to mild slope, 0% to 19%, do tree crowns/canopy have at least 10 feet of spacing in the 30 to 100 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Apply only when the slope is flat to mild.

entities.entity: For mild to moderate slope, 20% to 40%, do tree crowns/canopy have at least 20 feet of spacing in the 30 to 100 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Apply only when the slope is mild to moderate.

entities.entity: For moderate to steep slope, greater than 40%, do tree crowns/canopy have at least 30 feet of spacing in the 30 to 100 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Apply only when the slope is moderate to steep.

entities.entity: Are tree crowns/canopy appropriately spaced on the north side in the 30 to 100 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Use the spacing standard for the observed slope.
Use N/A if no north-side trees are present.

entities.entity: Are tree crowns/canopy appropriately spaced on the south side in the 30 to 100 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Use the spacing standard for the observed slope.
Use N/A if no south-side trees are present.

entities.entity: Are tree crowns/canopy appropriately spaced on the east side in the 30 to 100 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Use the spacing standard for the observed slope.
Use N/A if no east-side trees are present.

entities.entity: Are tree crowns/canopy appropriately spaced on the west side in the 30 to 100 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Use the spacing standard for the observed slope.
Use N/A if no west-side trees are present.

properties.group_name: Tree Crown and Canopy Spacing and Tree Clusters

queries.details: Inspect images showing naturally occurring shrubs, brush, unmanaged vegetation, vegetation density, slope, direction, and distance zones around the dwelling. Compare shrub spacing against the applicable slope rule.

entities.entity: Do naturally occurring shrubs, other than landscaping, have appropriate spacing according to slope in the 5 to 30 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Limit to naturally occurring shrubs in the 5 to 30 ft zone.
Exclude maintained landscaping.

entities.entity: For flat to mild slope, 0% to 19%, are naturally occurring shrubs in the 5 to 30 ft zone spaced at least 2 times the shrub height?
data_validation_rules: Apply only when the slope is flat to mild.

entities.entity: For mild to moderate slope, 20% to 40%, are naturally occurring shrubs in the 5 to 30 ft zone spaced at least 4 times the shrub height?
data_validation_rules: Apply only when the slope is mild to moderate.

entities.entity: For moderate to steep slope, greater than 40%, are naturally occurring shrubs in the 5 to 30 ft zone spaced at least 6 times the shrub height?
data_validation_rules: Apply only when the slope is moderate to steep.

entities.entity: Do naturally occurring shrubs, other than landscaping, have appropriate spacing according to slope in the 30 to 100 ft zone?
data_validation_rules: Limit to naturally occurring shrubs in the 30 to 100 ft zone.
Exclude maintained landscaping.

entities.entity: For flat to mild slope, 0% to 19%, are naturally occurring shrubs in the 30 to 100 ft zone spaced at least 2 times the shrub height?
data_validation_rules: Apply only when the slope is flat to mild.

entities.entity: For mild to moderate slope, 20% to 40%, are naturally occurring shrubs in the 30 to 100 ft zone spaced at least 4 times the shrub height?
data_validation_rules: Apply only when the slope is mild to moderate.

entities.entity: For moderate to steep slope, greater than 40%, are naturally occurring shrubs in the 30 to 100 ft zone spaced at least 6 times the shrub height?
data_validation_rules: Apply only when the slope is moderate to steep.

properties.group_name: Naturally Occurring Shrub Spacing by Zone and Slope

queries.details: Inspect images showing detached structures, sheds, pet houses, playsets, neighboring homes, propane tanks, butane tanks, woodpiles, lumber, and structures around the dwelling.

entities.entity: Are there structures/outbuildings, such as sheds, pet houses, etc., built with combustible materials, such as wood, vinyl, etc., that do not meet the following requirements: at least 10 feet away from the home or any attached decks, have a five foot noncombustible zone around each structure, have a minimum of six vertical inches of noncombustible siding material at the base, have elevated bases enclosed with 1/8 inch or finer metal wire mesh, are spaced at least 10 feet apart from other structures, and have no more than three such structures within 30 feet of the dwelling?
data_validation_rules: Limit to structures within 30 ft of the dwelling.
Answer Yes if any visible structure violates any listed requirement.
Use N/A if no applicable structures are present.

entities.entity: Do liquid gas, butane, or propane tanks larger than 20 lb grilling tanks have at least 10 feet of clearance from combustible material or any structure?
data_validation_rules: Apply only to tanks larger than 20 lb grilling tanks.
Check clearance from vegetation, mulch, and structures.

entities.entity: Are there wood piles at least 30 feet away from any structure, with at least 10 ft clearance from combustible material or any structure?
data_validation_rules: Apply only to visible wood piles.
Check distance from structures and combustible material.

entities.entity: Does a neighbor house within 100 ft of the dwelling have a wood roof?
data_validation_rules: Apply only to neighbor houses within 100 ft.
Use N/A if no neighbor house is present within 100 ft.

properties.group_name: Outbuildings, Accessory Structures, Woodpiles, Tanks, and Neighbor Exposure

queries.details: Inspect all exterior images showing the roof, gutters, porches, decks, stairways, yard, vegetation, brush, trees, grasses, and ground surfaces within 100 ft of the dwelling.

entities.entity: Is there an accumulation of leaves, needles, or other flammable debris on the property, including roof, gutters, porches, decks, stairways, or yard within 100 feet of the dwelling?
data_validation_rules: Minor scattered debris is not accumulation.
Answer Yes for visible buildup of flammable debris.

entities.entity: Are there dead trees or dead vegetation within 100 ft of the dwelling?
data_validation_rules: Look for dead trees, dead brush, and dry dead vegetation.

entities.entity: Are there unmaintained native grasses longer than 6 inches within 100 feet of the dwelling?
data_validation_rules: Focus on unmanaged native grasses.
Exclude maintained lawn.

properties.group_name: Whole-Property Debris, Dead Vegetation, and Native Grass Maintenance
